commemoration.title: Synaxis of the Archangel Michael and the Other Bodiless Powers

_note: Two OCA editions of one hymn. The base is the OCA service-texts DOCX (reference/scrape/2024-11-08.docx, "Prepared by the Department of Liturgical Music and Translations"); the parish sings the OCA engraved-music setting (© 2019 OCA) printed in its choir packet. Register is NOT the whole difference and a ?pronoun=yy render does not reach this wording — see memory project_register_knob_is_service_wide.

_provenance.family_note: OCA. The OCA service-texts DOCX; identical to the stichera row it stands in for.

value.text:
O Michael, first of Angels, fiery is thine appearance and miraculous thy beauty! Thou dost traverse creation by thine immaterial nature, fulfilling the commands of the Creator of all. By thy might thou art known as powerful,
and thou hast made thy temple, honored by thy holy name, a source of healings.

value.text:
Michael the Archangel,
fiery is your appearance and miraculous your beauty!
You traverse creation by immaterial nature,
fulfilling the commands of the creator of all.
By your might you are known as all powerful.
The temples honored by your Holy name//
you have made a source of healing!
